points: Uniform slate- or steel-blue dome papule.
Head and neck, backs of hands and feet, buttocks.
**Cellular blue naevus**: larger (over 1 cm), often on the buttocks or scalp.

items.t: New or changing blue papule in an adult, or a history of melanoma (metastasis looks blue): **suspected cancer pathway**.

pearls.t: Blue = deep pigment (Tyndall effect); brown = pigment near the surface.
